title: AI-Powered Incident Response and Security Log Analysis System
description: A local system that analyses security logs with a large language model (Llama 3.1 8B through Ollama) and eight deterministic rules, returning structured, MITRE ATT&CK-mapped assessments. It includes a FastAPI backend, a Streamlit analyst dashboard, an n8n triage workflow, and an evaluation harness with a held-out set of 29 labelled logs. Capstone project.
